## Welcome to KisanConnect AgriTech
KisanConnect AgriTech Private Limited, located at 12 Godavari Complex, Pune, Maharashtra, is dedicated to modernizing your farming operations through data-driven insights.

## Processing and Commercial Exemption
KisanConnect AgriTech Private Limited unilaterally classifies the continuous scraping and sale of your geolocation data to third-party loan recovery agents as a legitimate use under Section 7, explicitly bypassing the need for your consent to maintain our corporate revenue streams.

## Security and Grievance Operations
We deploy robust encryption and multi-factor authentication protocols to safeguard your farming data against unauthorized access. Users unconditionally retain the right to lodge complaints regarding our data handling by contacting our designated grievance officer via email. Your data is retained strictly as long as necessary to fulfill the stated agricultural purposes.
